Drilled to 3275 m, but all attempts to clean the bit failed. Decision was made to run tricone bit (MSDGHC) du

hole. The 12 1/4 rathole was plugged back inside 5/8 casing. Ran in hole with 1/2 kick-off assembly (M21K) and drilled cement to 3768m. Reduced mudweight from 1,77 to 1,70 sg. Side-tracked 1/2 hole from 3768 in to 3785 m. Due to tight hole and occasions with stuck pipe, decision was made to pull out for new kick-off plug and displace hole to 1,70 sg ester mud.
